subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should be treated as the canonical fix path for the macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs overlap the same root cause and differ in whether they fix the native LaunchAgent fallback, only reject the dashboard URL symptom, or touch gateway-side auth behavior.

options.title: Review the strongest native macOS fallback PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate if maintainers accept its SecretRef-compatible grammar and it gets adequate current-head real macOS proof.

options.title: Choose another linked macOS PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101330 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101526 instead if either provides cleaner upgrade behavior, stronger proof, or a smaller owner-boundary patch.

options.title: Request a replacement only if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a narrow replacement only if the existing linked PRs cannot be brought to a landable state.

recommendation.title: Review the strongest native macOS fallback PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate if maintainers accept its SecretRef-compatible grammar and it gets adequate current-head real macOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the current-main history on the native macOS endpoint and dashboard code where the canonical fix will likely land.
